verification.note: migrated from data/antibiogram-raw.json: extracted from the source PDF, then re-verified cell by cell by a second reader (2026). Method: Figures come from Table 2 (page 3), printed as n (%) sensitive, and were checked against the page 4 text. Piperacillin-tazobactam is printed as '1 (3%)' and colistin as '12 (28%)'. MDR and XDR counts in Table 3 are not per drug.

notes: Sharma et al. (Cureus 2023) studied Klebsiella pneumoniae from endotracheal aspirates of mechanically ventilated ICU patients with ventilator-associated pneumonia at Sri Guru Ram Das Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, Amritsar. This entry is the January to June 2022 cohort (42 isolates); a separate entry holds January to June 2018 (40). Figures are % susceptible as printed. The paper's headline finding is the fall in colistin susceptibility from 92% in 2018 to 28% in 2022; meropenem fell from 15% to 2.5%, minocycline rose from 67% to 100% and XDR strains rose from 62.5% to 71%. Ampicillin, 100% resistant in both periods by the text, is not in the table and is not shown. No ESBL rate is reported. Cotrimoxazole (50%) is printed without an isolate count.
